caption: The drawing depicts two spoons, rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a plain, light-colored background. Both spoons are oriented vertically with the bowls facing upward. The spoon on the left is plain with a smooth, slightly rounded handle that widens toward the end. The spoon on the right also has a similarly shaped bowl but features more decoration; its handle displays a subtle engraved design near the bowl and additional markings or engravings toward the broad end. The composition centers both objects side by side on the page with significant empty space surrounding them. In the lower right corner of the page, the artist's name "David P. Willoughby" is written in small handwriting.
title: Silver Teaspoon
